notes: Azahar 2126.1 official libretro core (src/citra_libretro), built with ENABLE_VULKAN=OFF: on Android a Vulkan-enabled build ignores GET_PREFERRED_HW_RENDER and forces Vulkan, so GLES-only is deliberate; citra_graphics_api=OpenGL pins it too. HW render: RETRO_HW_CONTEXT_OPENGLES3 version 3.2 (GLES 3.2 features are required, e.g. geometry shaders), bottom_left_origin=true, cache_context=false, depth/stencil NOT requested, pixel format XRGB8888, SET_HW_SHARED_CONTEXT is called. retro_get_system_av_info reports base 400x480 (Top-Bottom layout) but max_width/max_height = 7200x9600 (Side-by-Side at 10x); the frontend must NOT allocate the HW FBO from max_* eagerly - allocate lazily from base_*/SET_GEOMETRY (the core calls SET_GEOMETRY on every layout/resolution change) and reallocate on change. Touch: RETRO_DEVICE_POINTER port 0 (PRESSED/X/Y, -0x7fff..0x7fff over the whole output frame); the core maps the point into the bottom-screen rectangle of the current layout itself, touches outside it are ignored; RETRO_DEVICE_MOUSE is also polled. Only DECRYPTED ROMs run (.3ds/.cci/.cxi/.app/.3dsx/.elf; .cia install is not available in the libretro core). No BIOS/system files: built-in key blob + open-source system archives. Saves: retro_get_memory_data is NULL (no .srm); user dir is <GET_SAVE_DIRECTORY, fallback SYSTEM>/Azahar/ with nand/, sdmc/ (game saves), config/, shaders/ (disk shader cache). Memory is exposed via SET_MEMORY_MAPS. Savestates supported (format tied to core version). Optional env the frontend may skip: GET_VFS_INTERFACE (falls back to stdio), GET_SENSOR_INTERFACE (motion disabled by default), GET_MICROPHONE_INTERFACE. Perf levers: citra_shaders_accurate_mul=disabled, citra_resolution_factor. Needs ~1 GB native heap for many titles.
